round1.Q1 Where it lives: A: Markdown documents in the repository under docs/spec/, reviewed by PR
round1.Q2 Restate or point: A: self-contained; it states each rule in its final form, cites its source, and becomes the authority once confirmed
round1.Q3 Organization: A: by component, with an overview in to-spec's form and traceability tables
round1.Q4 Configuration and instructions fog: A: the specification sets the field names and the required content of the instructions; wording is written in implementation
round1.Q5 Writing and confirming: A: whole specification first, one document per Lavish review, then confirm the whole
round1.Q6 Implementation order: A: walking skeleton to a tested PR first, then widen in scenario order; the harness grows with each milestone
round1.Q7 Development tests: A: a scripted fake provider, from recorded payloads, in hosted CI; never counts as qualification
round1.Q8 Harness location: A: in the asmai repository, development builds only; a separate fixture repository
round1.Q9 Who builds AsmAI: A: Firstmate crews build it, PRs gated by no-mistakes; AsmAI works on itself from the release candidate
round1.Q10 The repository: B: in M0, before the first code commit, note: "I am planning to start the new repo "talvor/asmai" for implementation and will not bring across anything from this repo.  I will be running the "to-tickets" skill in the new repo on each of the spec files to generate the tickets in the new repositories issue tracker.  So any links in the specs that will get added to the tickets should refer to the current "talvor/AssemblyAI" repo"
round1.Q11 macOS: B: macOS alongside every milestone, certified after Linux
round1.Q12 Migrations kept from: A: from the first release candidate

round2.R2-Q4 Changes once code exists: A: the authority until v1.0.0, changed by PR here first; then frozen
round2.R2-Q5 macOS checks: A: hosted macOS tests on every PR; the harness on a Mac at each milestone's end; never holds up Linux
round2.R2-Q6 Milestones: A: as shown; each ends on closed tickets, green tests, passing cases and a recorded demo
round2.R2-Q7 Glossary and ADRs: A: a dated line in ADR 0008 for the fake provider; no new ADR
round2.R2-Q8 The map: A: no new ticket; the way to the specification is clear
